review_candidates.title: Senior Delivery Manager
review_candidates.description: Role Purpose The Senior Delivery Manager is responsible for the safe, reliable and cost-effective day-to-day delivery of operations. The role will lead field execution across production, facilities, maintenance and operational improvement activities, ensuring production targets are achieved while maintaining strong HSSE, asset integrity and operational discipline. The position will also coordinate closely with technical, project, logistics and PDVSA teams to support production growth, recovery improvement and EOR/IOR initiatives. Key Responsibilities Lead day-to-day field operations and ensure safe, reliable and efficient production. Support asset mobilization, operational readiness and transition activities ahead of and following operational takeover. Deliver production targets, including the planned progression from approximately 20.5 kbd toward 32 kbd peak production . Manage and optimize extra-heavy oil production operations, including wells, artificial lift, gathering systems, fluid handling and production allocation. Coordinate the operational implementation of EOR/IOR and production-enhancement projects , working closely with technical and project teams. Ensure effective operation and availability of pumping, separation, dehydration/treatment, storage and export facilities. Drive equipment reliability through preventive and risk-based maintenance, integrity management and effective management of critical spares. Manage operational issues associated with corrosion, fouling, sand production, produced water and other heavy-oil operating challenges. Coordinate diluent availability, storage, blending and field usage to maintain crude-quality requirements and uninterrupted production. Support the optimization of diluent consumption, production losses, deferment and operating costs to improve asset netback. Maintain high standards of HSSE, process safety and asset integrity , including H2S, hydrocarbon, pressure and hot-fluid risks. Ensure operational compliance with environmental, regulatory and company requirements. Coordinate field activities involving UCC personnel, PDVSA secondees, contractors and specialist service providers . Manage operational interfaces with PDVSA and other relevant partners and escalate significant operational, technical or commercial risks. Support brownfield modifications, debottlenecking, facility upgrades and capital projects, ensuring minimal disruption to ongoing operations. Maintain operational risk registers and business-continuity plans covering power, diluent supply, logistics, security and export constraints. Lead production performance reviews covering uptime, deferment, reliability, maintenance performance, operating cost and production losses. Ensure accurate production accounting, hydrocarbon allocation and operational KPI reporting. Drive continuous improvement, digital surveillance and data-driven operational decision-making. Develop field capability through coaching, technical training, competency development and knowledge transfer. Provide regular operational performance reports and recommendations to the Operations Director. Experience & Qualifications 15+ years of progressive upstream oil & gas experience , with significant responsibility for field operations and production delivery. Strong experience in heavy or extra-heavy oil operations is highly preferred. Demonstrated experience managing production operations, surface facilities and maintenance/reliability . Experience with artificial lift, fluid handling, gathering systems, crude treatment and production optimization . Good understanding of diluent management, crude blending and heavy-oil logistics . Practical experience supporting or delivering EOR/IOR, production enhancement, brownfield or debottlenecking projects . Experience managing mature assets, operational restarts, production ramp-ups or complex brownfield environments. Strong HSSE, process-safety and asset-integrity leadership experience. Experience working with national/state oil companies, joint ventures or partner-operated environments , preferably including PDVSA or comparable organizations. Proven ability to lead multidisciplinary operational teams, secondees, contractors and service companies. Strong commercial awareness with experience managing operating costs, production losses, reliability and asset performance. Degree in Petroleum Engineering, Mechanical Engineering, Process/Chemical Engineering or a related engineering discipline. Spanish and English capability is strongly preferred for the Venezuela operating environment.

review_candidates.description: About The Company At Smartness , we are building the future of hospitality tech. Our SaaS helps lodging providers boost revenues by 30%+ and get more direct bookings. We are the fastest-growing B2B SaaS in the industry, trusted by 4,000+ clients across 40+ countries , with billions of euros in bookings processed. Backed by top international investors and named one of Italy's Top 10 LinkedIn Startups, we are on a mission to scale globally. Want to grow with us? Let's go! About The Role What Will You Do? 🦾 Your mission will be simple: make sure our go-to-market machine runs smoothly. You will work at the intersection of Sales, Customer Success, Revenue Operations, and Leadership, helping teams stay aligned, ensuring information flows effectively, and supporting the operational backbone of a fast-growing company. Own and improve our GTM processes: As Smartness grows, processes naturally become more complex. You will be responsible for helping our commercial organization operate efficiently by continuously reviewing and improving workflows across Sales and Customer Success. You'll identify bottlenecks, spot communication gaps, and help create scalable ways of working that allow teams to move faster while staying aligned. You'll also ensure that process changes are properly documented, communicated, and adopted across the business. Drive cross-functional alignment: One of the biggest challenges in a growing organization is ensuring that information reaches the right people at the right time. You will act as a bridge between teams, helping coordinate initiatives, align stakeholders, and ensure everyone is working from the same playbook. Whether it's a process change, a strategic initiative, or an operational update, you'll help make sure communication is clear, consistent, and actionable. Become the operational backbone of our CRM ecosystem: CRM sits at the heart of many of our commercial processes, and you'll play a key role in making sure it remains accurate, reliable, and useful. You'll help maintain data quality, monitor workflows, support process adoption, and collaborate with stakeholders to improve how teams use our systems. You'll also develop a strong understanding of our broader GTM tech stack and how different tools interact to support the business. Bring structure to complexity: Not every project comes with a predefined roadmap. You'll help bring clarity and organization to ambiguous situations by coordinating activities, tracking progress, following up on commitments, and ensuring nothing important gets lost along the way. You will help transform ideas into repeatable processes and create visibility across ongoing initiatives. Enable operational excellence across the business: Your impact won't be limited to individual projects. You'll contribute to building a more efficient organization by improving internal communication, supporting operational initiatives, analyzing workflows, and identifying opportunities to make teams more effective. Success in this role means helping people spend less time dealing with operational friction and more time creating value for customers. What Are We Looking For? 👀 A strong cross-functional collaborator: You know how to work with different stakeholders, navigate competing priorities, and build alignment across teams. You are an excellent communicator who understands that operational excellence often depends on ensuring the right information reaches the right people at the right time. CRM and systems proficiency: You have previous experience working with CRM platforms, ideally Salesforce or Hubspot, and understand their importance in supporting commercial teams. You are comfortable working with data, maintaining system accuracy, and understanding how different tools and integrations support business operations. A process-oriented problem solver: You enjoy creating order where there is complexity. You naturally identify inefficiencies, communication gaps, and opportunities for improvement, and you take ownership of finding practical solutions. You are highly organized, detail-oriented, and comfortable managing multiple priorities simultaneously. Someone who is both strategic and hands-on: You enjoy thinking about how processes should work, but you're equally comfortable executing them. Whether it's reviewing CRM data, documenting workflows, coordinating projects, or following up on action items, you're happy to roll up your sleeves and get involved in the details. Experience in Operations, Enablement, or similar functions: You have at least 2 years of experience in roles such as Revenue Operations, Sales Operations, Business Operations, GTM Operations, Sales Enablement, Project Coordination, or similar positions where process improvement, stakeholder management, and operational execution played a central role. Experience in SaaS or high-growth technology companies is a strong plus. Thrives in fast-paced environments: You enjoy working in ambitious environments where things move quickly. Change doesn't overwhelm you - it energizes you. You can adapt, prioritize effectively, and maintain high standards even when juggling multiple initiatives. Fluent in English & Italian: You are comfortable communicating professionally in English & Italian, both written and spoken. What Does Success Look Like? 🚀 A Few Months Into The Role Teams know where to find information and who to involve. Process changes are communicated clearly and adopted successfully. CRM data becomes more reliable and actionable. Cross-functional initiatives move faster. Stakeholders feel more aligned and informed. Communication gaps decrease significantly. Teams spend less time dealing with operational confusion and more time executing. Most Importantly, People Stop Saying "I wasn't aware of this." "Nobody told me." "We're not aligned." What Do We Offer? 👌 Work in a small, high-performing team that moves extremely fast. Have a direct impact on how one of Europe's fastest-growing travel-tech companies operates. Collaborate closely with leadership and key stakeholders across the business. Join a culture where ownership matters more than hierarchy. Continuous learning and growth opportunities. A place where your ideas can genuinely improve how the company works. An environment where experimentation is encouraged and mistakes are part of the learning process. Remote-first working environment. Competitive compensation aligned with experience and impact. For our Revenue Management team, we typically offer an OTE package ranging from €35,000 to €40,000 annually, depending on experience, analytical capabilities, industry knowledge, and expected contribution to the company’s growth. Our compensation structure is designed to reward ownership, strategic thinking, and measurable business impact. As you grow within the company and contribute to revenue optimization, pricing strategy, and operational performance, your compensation can evolve accordingly. For candidates demonstrating exceptional expertise or a strong track record in revenue management and commercial strategy, we may consider compensation packages beyond the standard range. The opportunity to build scalable processes that will support the next phase of Smartness' growth. Before You Apply If you're reading this, it means you're genuinely interested, and that excites us. This role is for someone who enjoys bringing order to complexity. We move fast, priorities change, and there is often no playbook. You'll need curiosity, adaptability, and a willingness to take ownership when things are unclear. We're ambitious, demanding, and obsessed with continuous improvement. We care deeply about execution, communication, and accountability. If that sounds exciting rather than intimidating, we'd love to meet you. Come help us build the operational backbone that will support Smartness' next stage of growth. By submitting this application, I agree that my personal data will be collected, processed, and retained by the company solely for the purposes of managing and assessing my candidacy.

Screen and prioritize incoming calls, emails, correspondence, and requests. Prepare presentations, reports, letters, and official communications on behalf of the CEO. Maintain an organized filing system for confidential executive documents. Handle sensitive information with the highest level of confidentiality. B. Executive Coordination & Follow-up Coordinate communication between the CEO and department heads, managers, and external stakeholders. Follow up on instructions and decisions issued by the CEO. Monitor pending tasks and ensure timely execution by the concerned departments. Maintain an action tracker for management meetings and strategic initiatives.
